summary.intent: Get the alert-agent branch reviewed and merged by Akshat, verify the Entire/Brain setup works, then reconcile the alert agent with Akshat's rebuilt UI and card API after a review flagged inconsistencies.
summary.outcome: PR #3 was opened, found overtaken by Akshat's hand-merge into akshat/integration, and closed with a heads-up. Entire/Brain was fully repaired (Graph v0.6.0, refreshed). The alert agent's backend and UI were ported onto akshat/integration (shared send path, ASK_STATE_DIR, inbox state files, VoiceCall/AlertsButton, PWA), with 4 new tests passing; the work was committed locally but not yet pushed or opened as a new PR.

repo: Entire 0.13.4 stores checkpoints as per-checkpoint refs (refs/entire/checkpoints/<xx>/<id>), not in the old entire/checkpoints/v1 branch; verify with `git ls-remote origin 'refs/entire/checkpoints/*'`.
`entire plugin install graph` fails if the plugin is already installed; `--force` is needed to upgrade (v0.4.0 -> v0.6.0).

GitHub's 'ready to merge' only reflects textual conflicts with the PR target branch (akshat/dashboard), not semantic conflicts or that the work was merged by hand elsewhere (akshat/integration, commit f5dc402).
Akshat's new API stores actions.json as a list and uses decision_status.json, while the old alert-agent modules treated actions.json as a dict, so the two would corrupt each other's history.
State folder env var changed from ASK_SOONY_STATE_DIR to ASK_STATE_DIR.

The new UI has a single-decision page at /d/<id>, the right target for push notification taps; the old card route /api/cards/{id}/action is kept only as a bridge, with new endpoints approve/escalate/dismiss.
One alert test passes in isolation but failed in the full suite earlier, suggesting order sensitivity.

code.finding: Rewritten to read cards in Akshat's new card format and to share a single send/deliver path between voice and the Approve button.
Rewritten using Akshat's platform test fixtures for the new API; 4 tests pass.

workflow: When a push is chained after an output filter, a crash in the filter can swallow the push; verify with a separate check that the push landed.
Check the remote branch state and who actually merged what before trusting PR status; teammates may merge by hand into other branches.
Closing a PR with a descriptive note doubles as a GitHub-notified heads-up to the teammate about which files will be touched.
Lint only own files; pre-existing long lines in teammates' test files should be left alone.

friction: First push was lost because the output filter crashed, requiring a re-push and extra verification.
A shell quoting bug and a brief GitHub connectivity failure interrupted the checkpoint verification.
Another agent's claim that logs were missing came from looking in the old checkpoint branch.
`entire plugin install graph` failed on the first attempt because the plugin was already installed.
The PR was overtaken by Akshat's hand-merge into a rebuilt UI, so voice/push/PWA were missing from the new front end and needed a rebuild.
An alert test was flaky in the full-suite run.
open_items: Push the new branch from akshat/integration and open a merge request into it (not done yet in the transcript).
Ask Akshat to confirm removal of fixtures in web/fixtures and the old dashboard contract doc.
Investigate the order-dependent flaky alert test.
Build automatic escalation (critical card -> push -> phone call if unanswered).
Two Brain sessions are pending distillation.
Approve Codex hooks via /hooks if Codex is used.
Send Akshat a message about the new PR, since he may not be watching GitHub.
